cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. The sandwiches are floating. Is gravity late for lunch, or has it resigned? We need a serving plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The guests arrive in five minutes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Late means plates underneath. Resigned means string on every sandwich. Which are we doing?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then fetch the deep plates. We may get the whole buffet at once.

mechanism: A corrects a helper's urgency-only response into a choice between two gravity explanations, then supervises the selected serving method.
confusable: D150 investigates rules; D154 makes B choose an explanation as an operational decision.
comparison: Hospitality time pressure and available supplies differ from movers calling full-sized help.
seedUse: Keep delayed versus resigned gravity and string shortage, making A correct actual serving preparations.
